answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one mechanism: identity escrow bound to irreversibly sunk compute. To register, an agent must finish a sealed voyage of tasks whose cipher is keyed to a fresh beacon, so answers cannot be precomputed or resold. Each accepted answer is hashed into a non-transferable stake bond on that address. A farmer cloning an operator inherits a hollow record: the copy must post its own stake and repeat the whole voyage from zero, paying full compute per head. Validators also trace the funding graph, capping wallets fed by one treasury and burning the stake of duplicates.
